name: Re-No Stayin' Alive
source:
Ryou is a private detective. His girlfriend works in a music industry and requests that he escorted singer girls. A chain of incidents happens one by one with many of them of uncomprehendable nature. Ryou needs to get to the truth behind them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
